sections.label: ASSISTANT
sections.content: 现在理解了玩家结构：玩家是W框(5行,含蓝点中心b)+N基座(3行)。SPACE收集头顶1格的蓝点，将其并入W框。当前蓝点3(rows36-39)在玩家W框(rows40-44)正上方1格。按SPACE应收集蓝点3。

<function=python>
<parameter=code>
r = action(['SPACE'])
print("result:", {k:r[k] for k in ['action_num','board_changed','level_completed','done','reward','score']})
after = current_frame
print("AFTER nodes (non-bg):")
for n in after.segmentation['nodes']:
    if n['color'] not in ('w',):
        print(n['id'], n['color'], n['pixels'], n['boundary'])
lines = after.ascii.split('\n')
print("--- ascii 34-50 ---")
for rr in range(34, 50):
    print(rr, repr(lines[rr][28:40]))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
